scope: External public JSON snapshots and compiler transfer of frozen selected Auto v3; no tuning or public API changes.
platform: Same Windows x64 machine and Microsoft STL/CRT; isolate compiler rather than change OS/library.
order: Eight toolchain/policy pairs in cyclic order; each pair occupies every absolute position once, each within-toolchain position twice.

gates.non_tiny: Balanced parse median >=1 ms per compiler

meaning: External transfer evidence on five snapshots, not representative workload sampling or a runtime guarantee. No retuning, dropped inputs or target weakening after results.
data: All five original files, no minification, editing or synthetic repetition. Include every input, even failed acceptance or a failed resource gate.
